data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 深夜书斋的判例研读
data.description: 夜深人静的事务所书斋内，暖黄台灯照亮堆积如山的法律文献。弥子把金尖钢笔抵在唇间苦思冥想，微鼓的腮帮子带着可爱的孩子气。
data.action: sitting at mahogany desk, pen to lips, thinking deeply, slight adorable pout
data.lighting: 学生会图书角暖调复古台灯与高耸书柜木质暖影
data.promptProse: Surrounded by stacks of leather-bound law books in a late-night office, Iino Miko touches a fountain pen to her lips, deep in studious concentration under a warm desk lamp.
data.animaCaption: The cozy gold beam of the library desk lamp illuminates Miko's focused expression as she studies late into the night.
